saints.name: Jonas and Barachisius
saints.legacy: Martyrs of unwavering faith and courage
saints.summary: Saints Jonas and Barachisius were brothers and martyrs who lived during the reign of King Sapor of Persia. They courageously encouraged fellow Christians facing persecution and ultimately faced brutal tortures for their steadfast faith. Their unwavering commitment to Christ and their martyrdom serve as a powerful testament to the strength of Christian virtue in the face of suffering.
